name: PvP Competition (Player vs Player)
summary: Direct player-vs-player combat: correct answers generate attacks, defenses, or steals. Social dynamics create engagement and mild competitive tension.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates questions excellently. Multiplayer mechanics and action generation (attack names, animations) are deterministic templates. Full AI generability.

questionMechanic.description: ID of the wrapped question mechanic (e.g., 'multiple-choice', 'true-false').

questions.description: Array of question objects conforming to the wrapped mechanic's schema.

gameMode.description: Core mechanic: 'attack' (correct = damage opponent), 'defend' (correct = shield), 'steal' (correct = take resources), 'mixed' (varies by turn).

actionNames.description: Object with 'correct' and 'incorrect' action names (e.g., {correct: 'Snowball Throw', incorrect: 'Slip on Ice'}).

matchSize.description: Number of concurrent players (2 for duel, 4-8 for squad, up to 30 for royale).

ux.mobileNotes: Split-screen with opponent portrait + health bar on each side (top 30%). Question in center (40%). Large tap answer buttons (bottom 30%). Action animations between both players. Real-time sync. Leaderboard at end. Portrait orientation; landscape for tablets.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Cooperative-leaning; duels only (2 players). No stealing. Simple health mechanic (50 points). Friendly themes (snowball, bubbles). 5-10 questions. Encourages participation over winning.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Moderate competition; squads (4-6) allowed. Light stealing (1-2 points). Standard health/damage model. 10-20 questions. Leaderboard visible but not emphasized.
ageAdaptations.14-16: Full competitive; royales (8-30). Aggressive stealing (5+ points). Shields, power-ups, skill-based damage scaling. 20-30 questions. Ranked leaderboard, seasonal achievements.
